notes.title: Cyber-Doge 2077 Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello friends![/h3]
[h3]We have a new game coming out soon - Cyber-Doge 2077: Meme runner.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=wyzZi_0rXMk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]About the game[/h1]
Furious 3D runner about a pumped up dog. Run as far as possible! Collect coins! Set new records and enjoy a great soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383720/Cyberdoge_2077_Meme_runner/

[h2]If you like the game, please [u]add it to your Steam Wishlist.[/u][/h2]

Best regards,
Take Toad.

notes.title: Dungeon Master's QUEST
notes.notes:
If we get 150 reviews, then the developers will release a free DLC with the story of Dungeon Master.
This is a story about who he was in a past life. Where did his mask? How did he become the owner of a club of real men? All this you will learn in DLC.

[previewyoutube=Ka-nXPpkNQk;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37781466/b341cc2571c158376e82ecf31eba97e48b3d0445.gif[/img]

I wish you all a good mood.

Best regards,
Developers
